title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Great tits have yellow breast plumage, which contains carotenoid pigments obtained through their diet. Although urban populations of great tits are often reported to exhibit paler carotenoid colouration than rural populations, these patterns have rarely been tested along continuous fine-scale urbanisation gradients at a continental scale. See “paler within the city: carotenoid-based colouration covaries negatively with the proportion of impervious surface in great tit (Parus major) territories across Europe” (DOI: 10.1111/1365-2656.70355) for more information. Photo by Nicolas Bekka.
